name: Sherebiah
overview: Sherebiah is portrayed in Scripture as a faithful Levite who played a significant role in the spiritual leadership of Israel during the post-exilic period. As a Levite assistant to Ezra, he was entrusted with important responsibilities, including accompanying the returnees and supporting the priestly duties (Ezra 8:18, 8:24). Additionally, Sherebiah was among the Levites who helped the people understand God's law and led them in worship and covenant renewal under Nehemiah's leadership (Nehemiah 8:7, 9:4-5, 10:12). His involvement highlights the vital role of Levites in guiding God's people toward faithfulness and covenant commitment.
